_README: Verbatim from CONTENT_PACK §4. Note the BL wording: the build brief §4 explicitly corrects the earlier 'we issue both HBL and MBL' framing to 'Yentrans may issue House Bills of Lading where properly authorised; Master Bills are normally issued by the ocean carrier, and Yentrans coordinates carrier documentation as required.' That correction is deliberate and is tracked in APPROVALS_NEEDED.md.
intro: A movement is only as strong as the coordination behind it. Yentrans covers booking, documentation, specialised handling and inland transport, assembled around the cargo.

items.title: FCL Ocean Freight
items.summary: Full-container movements planned around equipment, realistic sailings and documentation — not whichever line sits top of a rate sheet.

items.title: LCL Consolidation
items.summary: Part loads consolidated to schedule, with the receiving windows and document consistency a shared container demands.

items.title: Reefer & Temperature-Controlled Logistics
items.summary: Temperature-sensitive cargo settled before it reaches the box: set point, equipment suitability, inland power and handover.
items.note: Temperature controls, monitoring availability and contractual liability are shipment-specific. We make no unverified unbroken cold-chain guarantee.

items.title: Customs Clearance & Documentation
items.summary: Invoice, packing list, entry, transport document and certificates checked against each other before a mismatch holds the container.
coordinate: BL instructions and shipment document checks
items.note: Yentrans may issue House Bills of Lading where properly authorised. Master Bills of Lading are normally issued by the ocean carrier; Yentrans coordinates carrier documentation as required.

items.title: Inland Transportation & Door Delivery
items.summary: Factory gate to port, or port to final destination — equipment, collection windows and container positioning in supported markets.

items.title: Project Cargo & Specialised Movements
items.summary: Out-of-gauge and heavy pieces assessed on drawings, weights and route restrictions before a rate means anything.

items.title: Warehousing & Cargo Insurance Coordination
items.summary: Storage before loading or after arrival, with cover coordinated to match the Incoterm rather than the assumption.

items.title: Defence Logistics & Naval Husbanding
items.summary: Port agency and husbanding for naval vessels: berthing, pilotage, waste, provisioning and crew support, attended around the clock.

coordinateGroups.title: Crew support ashore
items: Crew transfers to and from vessels

coordinateGroups.title: Coordination and response
items: Force protection item rental and placement

items.note: The naval division is newer than our freight business and growing. Where a port sits outside our own offices, attendance is delivered with established agency partners, and scope is confirmed per call.
